key.name: timeout-seconds
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the keyboard backlight turns off. Use 0 to disable the timer (light stays on until you turn it off). Range is 0–30 seconds.

key.name: low-only
key.description: When enabled, the keyboard backlight can only be off or at the lowest brightness. The Quick Settings intensity control is hidden, and the keyboard hotkey only switches between those two states.

key.name: last-brightness
key.summary: Last brightness chosen by the user
key.description: Restored at login, so the timer turning the light off before shutdown does not leave it off at the next boot. -1 means unknown.
